rules: Supply expected identity from a separately trusted original owned-process launch/handle record, including full PID+birth and exact argv. Never reconstruct missing birth, nonce or command from a PID or stale LOCK_HELD file.

Heartbeat and independent process observation are separate supplied JSON DATA. An old launch record is neither. If permission or evidence for an observation is absent, pass None; do not probe or synthesize it in the projector.
The caller must supply its current trustworthy UTC time. Reusing an old launch clock as now would only ask about that old instant; the pure projector cannot authenticate a clock or an observer.

Read status explicitly: report['status'] == 'VERIFIED_ACTIVE'. Do not use bool(report), bool(report['identity']), exit-code0, a nonempty JSON, LOCK_HELD or LAUNCH as an active count. All valid JSON report dicts are truthy, including UNKNOWN.

OBSERVED_EXIT is distinct from NOT_OBSERVED and STALE. None of these statuses authorizes clearing a lock, releasing/expiring a lease, killing/restarting a process or repeating a POST or business action.

VERIFIED_ACTIVE concerns the supplied process/heartbeat identity only. It does not prove task progress, a live model HTTP request, backend slot, service health, actual60 agents, source adoption or gameplay success.

Continue to use pool_observer for POST/END event intervals and Dispatcher/LeaseStore for their existing owned lifecycle and admission rules. This module does not replace either or change their histories.

Integration must preserve the exact reviewed module bytes and public v1 schemas. Do not silently normalize argv, clamp future times, replace foreign identities or auto-convert legacy metadata into a valid heartbeat.

Native alone runs the new independent public DATA witness; Models alone publishes shared source and chooses actual pipeline integration. Do not run old green suites or restart a worker for this source packet.
status_at_this_cut: Source+AST candidate; new Native witness pending. No actual liveness dataset, live probe, consumer adoption or operational action was performed by the source owner.
